svg.aria-label: Full schematic of the solar charger selector
svg.text: Dots are connections. Wires that cross without a dot are NOT connected.
A · PV POWER (heavy wire, sized for array current)
BAT+ → sense divider, BAT− → control GND (sheet 3)
BAT+ → sense divider, BAT− → control GND (sheet 3)
BAT+ → sense divider, BAT− → control GND (sheet 3)
B · 12 V CONTROL (relay coils, MOSFETs, Arduino) — separate battery, shares nothing with the PV wiring
Coil current ≈ 150 mA per relay, ≈ 300 mA per pair. Only one pair is on at a time.
Diode stripe (cathode) goes to pin 86 / +12 V. Every coil gets its own diode. LED1–LED3 light while their pin is HIGH = that battery charging.
